description: Fix lesson generation 500 error by switching from unreliable openrouter/auto model to a specific free model (meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free), and improve error handling
steps: In src/lib/gemini.ts, change the OPENROUTER_MODEL constant from 'openrouter/auto' to 'meta-llama/llama-3.3-70b-instruct:free' which is a specific free model on OpenRouter that does not require credits
Add GEMINI_URL and GEMINI_MODEL constants for Gemini API as third fallback provider
Add retry logic: if the first OpenRouter call fails with a 5xx or rate-limit, retry once with a 2-second delay before falling through to next provider
In the callProvider function, add response_format: { type: 'json_object' } for all providers (OpenRouter, Groq, Gemini) to improve JSON generation reliability
Add name field to provider objects for better error reporting
Track attempted providers and include them in the error message
In src/app/api/generate-lesson/route.ts, improve error messages: if all providers fail, return a more user-friendly detail message explaining which providers were attempted
acceptance_criteria: The provider chain tries OpenRouter, then Groq, then Gemini as fallbacks
Retry logic retries OpenRouter once on 5xx/429 errors with 2s delay
response_format: { type: 'json_object' } is set for all providers
Error message includes all attempted providers
verification: TypeScript syntax is valid (verified manually due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode)
findings: Build and lint verification could not be run because node_modules are not fully installed in this sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode). The code changes follow existing patterns exactly and are syntactically valid TypeScript.
